audit.whatIsWrong: Jax's ultimate was called 'Grandmaster's Might' in three places — that is the old name; Riot's is Grandmaster-at-Arms. report[5] gave Counter Strike an 8s cooldown and said it dodges 'autos/spin'.
audit.why: Counter Strike is 17/15/13/11/9 — more than double the stated 8s at rank 1, which is the difference between one punish window and three. And Riot's text is 'dodge all incoming attacks': it dodges basic attacks, not ability damage, so Judgment's spin still ticks on him through the channel. A Garen told his spin is dodged will walk away from a trade he is winning.
audit.corrected: Grandmaster-at-Arms named throughout; the real 17s/9s cooldown written in; the attacks-not-abilities distinction stated in report[5] and spikes[3].

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Jax Levels 1, 2 and 6 and called 3 and 4-5 'Skill' — while whys[0] through whys[4] say 'favours you', 'stays yours', 'you dominate', 'remain yours', 'favours you'.
audit.why: 57.79% over 7987 games, and the packet chart is Garen for all five early stages with Jax only from first item. This is the second-largest sample in the slice and the tokens disagreed with both the data and the page's own prose.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped as one group to Garen through Level 6, Jax at first item and 2+ items, with both summary lines rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes listed only 'His windows' and named five of them; report[2] said Garen's window was 'your item spikes'.
audit.why: Garen owns Levels 1 through 6 here. His real spike is Courage at level 3 (22s at rank 1) into a 17s Counter Strike; Jax's is his first completed item.
audit.corrected: Both summary lines rebuilt on the corrected stages.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing named Empower as an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Empower is a flat 3s at max rank and resets his attack — the wind-up animation is the cue to step out, not the cast, which is unreactable. It is also the reason his 'auto' damage spikes without any visible ability animation.
audit.corrected: The reset tell written into dosFull[0].d and the Empower cooldown into late.

notes: 'Grandmaster's Might' is a wrong-name error of exactly the calibration type — a plausible old name for Grandmaster-at-Arms, repeated three times. The mechanical fix that matters most is Counter Strike: it was written as an 8s cooldown that dodges Garen's spin; it is 17s at rank 1 and dodges attacks only, so Judgment keeps ticking through it. The packet's suspectNames flag on "Counter Strike's" is a false positive (apostrophe). spikes[0] and mid both claim the Q silence 'cancels his Counter Strike mid-channel' — whether a silence interrupts an already-active channel is not answerable from the kit files, so I left those lines untouched. No mirror audit exists for jax__garen.
